svg.title: The DTW cost grid of mon and sat with the window w = 4
svg.desc: A 48 by 48 grid: rows are the samples i of mon (drawn along the left edge, time upward), columns the samples j of sat (drawn below). Only the band |i − j| ≤ 4 is drawn. Higher opacity means higher local cost, the squared difference of the two samples (not the accumulated cost), from 0 to 2.51 in the band, with opacity growing as its square root. The dashed diagonal is lock-step matching. The warping path runs from the bottom-left corner to the top-right corner inside the band, at most 3 samples off the diagonal.
